artboards.title: Device motion - no tilt, dock into header
B - telemetry, now the dev screen

annotations.text:
#6D28D9 measures 2.78:1 as text on the dark background - below the 4.5:1 floor for text and even the 3:1 floor for UI.

So it is a FILL colour, with light content on it (6.37:1). Purple text and icons use #A78BFA (7.25:1).

That also means the record button's icon is light, not dark - the earlier mockup had this wrong.

DECIDED: no tilt, dock.

The board now lands in a real 38x46 slot beside the device name instead of a guessed offset, so it no longer overlaps.

One consequence to confirm: this adds a leading logo slot to the Home header and shifts the name/status block right by 50px. That changes a screen you already approved.

Still open: the 96px scan control and the reworked playback waveform on the main flow board.
